For new targets: "Baseline hyperparameter and training-duration selection use the released test split, which is also used for final reporting; no separate validation split" (App F). c4: P, "we report one complete run per method-configuration ... repeated baseline evaluations estimate the reference score"; "preliminary independent runs ... ordering was consistent" (App B.5), no spread; transfer candidates have three-seed mean ± sd (App F). c5: P, peer replay, larger-scale KuaiRand-27K, and transfer to KuaiVideo/VK-LSVD excluded from search (Sec 3.1); no val-vs-test comparison. c6: N, Optuna CMA-ES only calibrates the starting model; comparisons are LLM evolvers. c8: tuned, "Baseline HPO tunes the unmodified starting implementation separately for each instance before evolutionary search" (App A.7). c1: online, headline is "nine production Launch Reviews documented positive online lifts", with summed lifts (Abstract, Table 1); offline metrics are not the headline. c2: NS, KEEP/PACK decisions use "a fixed offline evaluation contract defined by engineers", with click and watch-time metrics "combined into a scalar proxy" (Sec 3); no split named. c3: NS, an offline evaluation exists, so not na. c4: N, "noise calibration was disabled in the audited configuration" (Sec 5); online evidence lacks "confidence intervals, or candidate denominators" (Limitations). c5: P, engineer-selected candidates moved to online A/B; "the audited archive does not retain complete immutable linkage between offline candidates and online packages" (Sec 3). c6: N. c8: production, candidates are judged against the active production trunk. c9: P, "A read-only preflight stage verifies ... frozen objectives or evaluation logic are not modified" (Sec 3.3); "deterministic controllers retain authority over execution, metric extraction, guardrails" (Abstract). incident: Y, "Long-running operation also revealed the KEEP ratchet ... a non-reproducible promotion can propagate ... and create apparent progress that may not persist" (Sec 5, 7). This is metric inflation through selection noise, not deliberate gaming.

Headline is hard to pin: the contribution is evidence qualification (verification rates, Table 1). The only gain over a deployed system is "positive online lifts relative to deployed baselines" (Abstract; Table 8: +0.75% page duration, +6.34% net growth utility), coded online. Offline AUC rounds (Fig 2) are a descriptive non-monotonicity finding; auc or other are alternative readings. c2/c3: NS, rounds are judged by "machine evaluation" under an "evaluation protocol" whose split is never named (Method). c4: N, memory pairs are single runs sharing a "random seed" (Memory-Conditioned Adaptation); no spread. c5: P, two candidates tested online against frozen production baselines (Table 8); "for 22 methods, the last round falls below an earlier best" (Fig 2) is not a held-out check. c6: N. c8: production, "positive online lifts over frozen production baselines"; adaptations start from "the same industrial RankMixer baseline" (Fig 2). c9: P, context-isolated generate-verify-repair and execution gates including an evaluation gate (Eq. 3); nothing on test access. incident: none reported.
